detailed_description: The Image Adjustment tool provides granular control over raster image processing through a web interface, enabling manipulation of luminance values, color channels, and spatial filters. Technically, it leverages HTML5 Canvas for client-side pixel manipulation and WebGL shaders for real-time rendering of adjustments. Users can modify brightness via luminance channel scaling, adjust contrast using sigmoidal transfer functions, and manipulate saturation through HSL color space conversion. Advanced features include per-channel RGB curve adjustments, unsharp masking for sharpening, and gamma correction for display calibration. This tool addresses needs across photography (post-processing RAW conversions), UI/UX design (asset optimization), and digital marketing (visual consistency). All operations occur in-browser via WebAssembly modules, preserving privacy and supporting non-destructive editing through layer composites. Histogram analysis tools help users identify clipping points and dynamic range issues.
usage_steps: 1. Click 'Upload Image' to load a bitmap (PNG/JPEG/WebP) or vector (SVG) file up to 25MB
2. Use the 'Brightness' slider to adjust luminance values with real-time preview in the split-view comparator
3. Engage 'Advanced Mode' to access individual RGB channel curves and CMYK color space conversion
4. Apply unsharp masking via the 'Sharpen' panel with customizable radius (0.3-5.0px) and amount (50-150%)
5. Utilize the 'Histogram Equalization' toggle to automatically balance tonal distribution
6. Click 'Download Adjusted Image' to export with custom DPI settings (72-1200) and compression level
usage_examples: Example 1: A photographer normalizes exposure across a product shoot by matching histograms and applying lens correction profiles
Example 2: A web designer reduces image file size by adjusting JPEG quality to 85 while maintaining visual fidelity
Example 3: A social media manager creates Instagram stories with consistent color grading using HSL presets
Example 4: An OCR specialist enhances document scans by increasing contrast and applying adaptive thresholding
